facts.fact: South Africa's Information Regulator, with a chief executive officer and a chairperson, is described as holding a mandate to enforce privacy and access to information, and signed an MoU with Zimbabwe's POTRAZ.
South Africa's Information Regulator, led by a chief executive officer and chairperson, is stated to have a mandate to enforce access to information and protection of personal information.

ZAF.note: The document describes a regulator-to-regulator MoU on cross-border data flows, not a transfer rule, route or ratification.
The document says nothing about a national ID system.
A bilateral regulator MoU citing the SADC Model Law as background is not a signature, ratification, national law or cross-border application of a shared text.
